tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all tests pass
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Run the full Vitest test suite to verify all existing tests pass without modification.
2. READ FIRST: Review src/components/Calculator.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, and src/App.test.tsx to understand what is being tested.
3. FILES: No files to modify — this is a validation-only task.
4. APPROACH: Run `npx vitest run` from the project root to execute all tests. Capture output and report any failures.
5. PATTERNS: The project uses Vitest with @testing-library/react. Tests are co-located with components in src/components/.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run exits with code 0
All test suites in src/components/*.test.tsx and src/App.test.tsx pass with no failures
No TypeScript compilation errors: npx tsc --noEmit exits code 0
